lead.headline: Down 66.6 with Allen and Jefferson to come
lead.deck: Allgeier and Diggs gave little; a 7% chance. Boston's 7 targets make Tuesday's claim real.
lead.body: The bad news first: the early games went against AVIATO. Diggs drew 5 targets for 8.1 in a 20-13 loss to the Rams, Ollie Gordon managed 7.4 against Detroit's run defence, Allgeier had 5 carries for 3.9 early at Seattle, and Garrett Wilson sat out with the concussion. Talla Metralla lead 130.22 to 63.6 and ESPN gives about a 7% chance. The lineup was right — Tuten's 8.9 beat Kamara's 7.9 and the Giants D/ST's 13 beat the dropped Commanders' 6 — but there is nothing left to set. The week's real decision is Tuesday: Denzel Boston drew 7 targets for 98 yards with Shedeur Sanders, the condition the morning run named, and the question is only who to drop.
